name: Russian CEE Kinetic and Sabotage Campaign
summary: Russian operations continue with drone attacks prompting maritime sinkings in Bulgaria's EEZ, while retaliatory Ukrainian strikes reach Surgut (2,400km deep) and force nightly Moscow airspace shutdowns.

name: Commercial BMS and Cold-Chain Disruption Campaign
summary: Coordinated manipulation of exposed Danfoss, Copeland, and Dixell BMS controllers across French supermarkets, driving heating defrost cycles to 50-80°C and ruining millions of euros of retail food inventory.

name: n0n Maritime and Logistics Extortion Wave
summary: Financially motivated extortion collective posting exfiltrated operational EDI feeds, manifests, and system configurations from 38 port and shipping entities across 18 countries via a compromised shared logistics application.

name: AdFection Mercenary Spyware Campaign
summary: Commercial spyware delivery network leveraging Discover-Tech's Controlium RTB platform to deliver zero-click Candiru spyware onto high-profile targets across Al Jazeera and international diplomacy.

name: Armory Castle Zero-Day Exploitation Cluster
summary: Chinese state-sponsored APT exploiting BeyondTrust zero-day vulnerability CVE-2026-102764 for initial perimeter compromise, log purging, and persistence across enterprise networks.

name: YAM Store Phishing and Impersonation Ecosystem
summary: Massive Chinese-language cybercrime syndicates (YAM Store, CoGUI, Iron Man) generating over 1 billion phishing messages across 150 countries, recently targeted by joint Microsoft and Health-ISAC domain seizures.

name: Ivanti Connect Secure Zero-Day Exploitation Cluster
summary: Threat actor UTA0576 and opportunists weaponizing CVE-2026-104935 to bypass authentication and gain root persistence across perimeter gateways, triggering urgent warnings from CISA and NBSZ NKI.

name: GhostAction CI/CD Credential Exfiltration Wave
summary: Large-scale compromise of developer accounts and enterprise code repositories, including Meta GitHub source pools, to exfiltrate proprietary code, CI secrets, and deployment keys.
